fields.climate: temperate; mild, wet winters; hot, dry summers
fields.terrain: mountainous with ranges extending into the sea as peninsulas or chains of islands
fields.hazards: severe earthquakes; volcanism: Santorini (367 m) has been deemed a Decade Volcano by the International Association of Volcanology and Chemistry of the Earth's Interior, worthy of study due to its explosive history and close proximity to human populations…

fields.farm: maize, wheat, sheep milk, oranges, tomatoes, milk, peaches/nectarines, grapes, watermelons, barley
fields.exports: refined petroleum, packaged medicine, aluminum, olive oil, tobacco
fields.industries: tourism, food and tobacco processing, textiles, chemicals, metal products; mining, petroleum
fields.religions: Greek Orthodox 81-90%, Muslim 2%, other 3%, none 4-15%, unspecified 1%
fields.legal: civil legal system based on Roman law
fields.suffrage: 17 years of age; universal and compulsory
fields.military: 18 years of age for voluntary military service for men and women; all Greek men 19-45 are subject to compulsory military service…
